Maya: Reminder — EU slice rollout window in 2h. This thread is for last-minute freeze confirmation, pins, rollback sanity, and exemption requests. Keep replies concise.
Deploy Bot: Canary queued by @Maya. id=canary-eu-6202024200. I'll post lifecycle updates. :robot_face: 
Ravi: Infra status: eu-west nodes warmed, persistent cache preloaded, no infra schema changes.
Jun: Traffic plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% with manual hold at each step. Hold toggles tested.
Claire: Pins: model=v4.1.0 sha=a1b2c3, runtime=rwinf-9.0.1 44D. Telemetry flag ENABLE_ROLLBACK_METRICS enabled. Release notes live (internal) https://internal.redwood/release/v4.1.0-draft
Maya: Freeze window starts 30m before first traffic shift and lasts until +2h after final step. Exemption flow: post request here with reason + owner, product + eng-lead must approve.
Eve (PM): Approved messaging for internal comms. Public publish blocked until US slice completes.
Deploy Bot: Canary started -> status=warming -> health checks running. Logs: `pull -> load-weights -> kv-check -> ready`
Ravi: Real-path smoke OK. First 40 requests no 5xx.
Jun: Quick check: dashboards open? manual pause ready? rollback runbook reachable? Reply yes/no.
Claire: yes/yes/yes
Eve (PM): yes
Maya: GO/NO_GO votes — reply with GO or NO_GO. If silent within 8m, assume GO from eng.
Ravi: GO
Jun: GO
Claire: GO
Eve (PM): GO
Deploy Bot: Canary health: p50=30ms p95=130ms errors=0.12% (<0.5%)
Oncall Bot: Alert sweep: no criticals. Minor transient 429s during warmup under threshold.
Maya: Initiating 0.5% canary. Abort criteria: errors >0.5% or p95>200ms for 5m rolling. Rollback command (staged-tested):
```
# rollback to previous stable
deploy rollback --service inference --to-version v4.0.9 --reason "canary fail"
infra drain --tag canary-eu-6202024200
```
Jun: 5m checkpoint: metrics stable, proceeding to 5% step. Manual hold engaged at transition.
Claire: Note: any manual pause must include ticket link and short reason for audit.
Ravi: Prepared oncall-rollback alias to reduce typo risk. Will DM oncall.
Maya: Reminder: during freeze no code merges to main unless exemption approved here. If hotfix needed during freeze, open ticket and tag @Maya + @Eve.
Eve (PM): Docs follow-up flagged; will merge patch after EU completes.
Deploy Bot: Traffic updated -> 5% started. canary-eu-6202024200 route:update ok
Oncall Bot: Watcher: latency +8ms baseline shift but under alert threshold. Continuing watch.
Maya: Thanks all. Will post final completion or rollback here. Freezing thread for noise. :lock:
